name: Momozono Momo
source: Childhood friend of protagonist, after briefly reuniting by chance found him to be intolerable. Is desperately in need of job/money when she applies for a cafe job. Little did she know the ad she applied to was a maid cafe and happen to be interview for a maid. Initial was against job but once she found out how much money make eventual agreed.
